correctness.rationale: Every one of 3422 normalized signed kernels is checked at primes 1000000007 and 1000000009; their product exceeds the Hadamard bound on every 60x60 integer matrix minor, so common finite-field ranks equal complex ranks. An independently built rational checker verifies all 23 orbit representatives. The 23 orbit sets are generated by all S5 conjugations and positive-site swap, are disjoint and exhaustive, and yield 102660 signed kernels with no double counting. The intrinsic rank formula and five-cycle class test are explicitly tested on all normalized pairs. The supplied scripts replayed successfully from actual standalone artifact paths.
